login.title: Sign In
login.expired: Your session ended: sign in again.
login.wrong: Wrong user name, password or code
login.wrongCode: Wrong code: check your authenticator's clock, or use a recovery code
setup.title: Set up Shed's nexus
setup.intro: Choose the user name and password you will sign in with. This happens once, for this nexus.
setup.codeHint: From the setup link: the nexus writes it to setup-link.txt in its data folder, and its log says where that is
setup.mismatch: The passwords are not the same
setup.badCode: The setup code is not right, or has been used. Check setup-link.txt in the nexus's data folder.
setup.totpIntro: Every sign-in also asks for a code from an authenticator app. Scan this with it, or type the key in.
setup.qrAlt: QR code to add Shed to an authenticator app
setup.longerCodes: Authy shows 7 digits? Type them all, or the last 6.
setup.totp: The code the app shows now
setup.wrongTotp: Wrong code — check that this device's and the server's clocks are right
setup.recoveryIntro: If you lose the authenticator, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe, away from this device: they are shown only now.
setup.noCodes: The nexus gave no recovery codes.
setup.fileHeader: Shed recovery codes: each signs in once, in place of the authenticator's code.
devices.title: Devices
devices.noPairing: To link a workspace, run this on it, then approve it here with the code it prints:
devices.approveBody: Type the code that `shed nexus join` printed on the workspace. Once approved, the workspace can be seen and driven from here.
devices.name: Name
devices.revokeBody: It is disconnected at once and must sign in or pair again.
devices.revokeCurrent: This is the browser you are using: it is signed out at once.
settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordNote: Every other browser and phone is signed out; workspaces stay paired.
settings.wrongPassword: The current password or the code is not right
push.title: Notifications
push.intro: This browser can tell you when Claude needs you or is done, even with Shed closed. While Shed is open in front of you, here or on another device, notifications show inside it instead.
push.support.insecure: Notifications need the nexus over HTTPS.
push.support.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
push.support.ios-install: On iPhone and iPad, add Shed to the Home Screen (Share, Add to Home Screen) and open it from there to get notifications.
push.off: Push notifications are off on this nexus.
push.disabled: Notifications are off for this browser
push.notAllowed: The browser did not allow notifications: allow them for this site in its settings.
push.kindHint.aiWaiting: A permission to give or a question to answer
push.kindHint.aiDone: An AI tab finished its turn
push.kindHint.workspaceOffline: It lost its connection to the nexus

bench.badge.body: A short word on the bench's icon; empty for none.

bench.close.body: Its programs stop and its teardown runs. It is saved and can be opened again.
bench.delete.title: Delete {name}?
bench.delete.body: Its saved file is removed: its tabs, layout, setup and scrollback are gone for good.
bench.new.title: New Bench
bench.new.name: Name
bench.new.placeholder: A name, or empty for one made up
bench.offline: {name} is offline: what is in this tab shows when it is back.
bench.gone: This bench is not running (it was closed, or is on another workspace).

tab.privateBody: A private tab: what is in it stays on its workspace.
tab.reconnected: Reconnecting: the shell on the server stays as it is.
tab.close.title: Close {name}?

“{title}”
{date} · {prompts}{later}.

Claude Code's files for it move to Shed's trash (~/.local/state/shed/ai-trash), kept 30 days, then deleted.

ai.sessions.deleteLater.other: , and {n} later sessions that continue it

ai.review.none: Nothing changed in the repositories this tab works in.
ai.review.unsupported: Reviewing changes is not offered by this workspace's Shed yet.
ai.paused: The workspace went offline: the conversation goes on when it is back.
ai.ended: This conversation is no longer shown here.
ai.emptySession: A new session: write below to start.
ai.browserOn: Connected to the browser (Claude in Chrome)
ai.queued.one: {n} message waits for this turn to end
ai.queued.other: {n} messages wait for this turn to end
ai.deleteDraft.title: Delete this draft?
ai.mergeDraft.tip: Add the draft's text at the end of the prompt; the draft stays here
ai.fullAuto.title: Let Claude do everything without asking?
ai.fullAuto.body: In Full Auto, Claude changes files and runs commands with no permission asked, until you change the mode.
ai.follow: Open files Claude edits in their project tab (on the workspace)
ai.browser: Let Claude use your browser (Claude in Chrome)
ai.resend.title: Send this message again?
ai.resend.body: The conversation goes back to it: the messages after it go, and the files Claude changed since are put back.
ai.revertTitle: Go back to before this message?
ai.revertBody: This message and everything after it leave the conversation (it stays in the list as it was).
ai.run.stepsUnknown: Its steps are not known here
ai.timer.note: Claude Code does it while it keeps running for this tab. Closing the tab or its bench, changing the tab's folders or effort, or stopping Shed's keeper cancels it.
ai.prompt.editing: Editing an earlier message: sending goes back to it
ai.prompt.placeholderQueue: Claude is working: what you send waits for the turn to end
ai.prompt.label: Message to Claude
ai.prompt.draftTip: Keep the message to send later
ai.prompt.fileTooLarge: {name} is larger than {max}: it cannot be attached
ai.prompt.waitUploads: Wait for the attached files to reach the workspace

ai.fullAuto.short: Changes files and runs commands without asking
ai.folderAddTitle: A folder for Claude to work in too
ai.foldersNote: Claude may read and change these folders too, from the next prompt.
